title: An image has the wrong resolution
summary: A controlled response for stopping unsuitable imagery from progressing while preserving the source file and approval history.
contentNotice: Demonstration playbook for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy and must be reviewed before operational use.
scenario: Use this when an image is too small, incorrectly exported, visibly degraded or otherwise unsuitable for its intended MOSCATELLI output.
immediateAction: Do not upscale or overwrite the source file merely to make the dimensions appear compliant.
Identify the intended output and the actual pixel dimensions/file characteristics.
Locate the highest-quality source or request a new export before approval continues.

whoToInform.when: When the asset cannot meet the intended output without source replacement.
When a new export or original file is required.

escalationConditions: The image has already been distributed or published in the wrong form.
Repeated export errors indicate an asset-management workflow problem.
